purpose: Measure physical GPU-hot/CPU-cold CSA value-block tiering
checkpoints: M1 S55 and S151 checkpoints referenced by SHA-256
hardware: one CUDA accelerator; exact device recorded in result

quality.task: generated associative recall; no raw token persistence
quality.comparison: resident cached decode versus tiered cached decode

measurements: resident compressor bytes and tier logical/hot/host bytes
H2D/D2H bytes and counts, useful bytes, prefetches, evictions, late misses
bitwise logits, greedy tokens, associative-recall accuracy

gates.correctness: greedy tokens equal and logits allclose at bfloat16 tolerance (atol 0.125, rtol 0.01) in every runtime scenario; bitwise equality reported separately
gates.quality: tiered and resident associative-recall accuracy equal
gates.memory: positive torch.cuda.memory_allocated reduction in native-topk batch-1 scenarios
gates.runtime: native-topk batch-1 p95 latency <= 1.25x resident or throughput >= 0.80x
gates.dense_fallback: correctness preserved; memory reduction is not required

interpretation: single-device reference-runtime evidence, not a production serving claim
